Value: Black spires pierce the sky from the village.
The air in the city tastes of copper and rot.
Scavengers still prowl the streets of the city.
The old temple district contains ruins and narrow passages.
A courtyard exists within the old temple district, containing twisted vines with sickly luminescence and a ruined fountain filled with stagnant black water.
The main hall of the temple is located beyond the courtyard in the fog.
A massive structure far larger and darker than the temple is rising out of the mist near the courtyard.
A barrier of shimmering light materialized across the temple entrance.
The immense shape above the temple stands higher than surrounding roofs, black against clouds, crowned by shifting green lights.
Green lights have awakened in windows, streets, and broken towers throughout the city.
Only the spires and the towering shape remain visible above the fog.
The forest is described as ancient, with gnarled trees and roots forming natural barriers.
The forest is ancient, with gnarled trees and roots forming natural barriers.
The edge of the forest reveals open, rolling hills beyond.
The watchfort is located at the bottom of a slope outside the forest.
Elias and Kaelen have reached the watchfort safely.
The hydraulic throat clearing contains a narrow channel between two twisted stone pillars where Blight sludge is present.
The Blight fog has lifted from the area around the watchfort and forest.
The air no longer tastes of copper and rot.
The black spires of the village are still visible against the gray sky.
The Pick and Axe tavern is open and operating with patrons.
The Pick and Axe common room is clean, with polished wood and a hearth.
The stranger exists and is an established character.
Elias Thorne wears leather armor.
Elias Thorne knows the mechanics of the Blight fog danger better than anyone.
Elias Thorne is traveling with Kaelen.
Elias Thorne possesses a bronze plate map etched with lines showing the temple, six smaller shrines, and channels beneath the city.
Elias Thorne exists and is an established character.
Elias Thorne possesses a quartz stone.
Elias Thorne possesses a chisel.
Elias Thorne is capable of using the quartz stone and chisel to generate resonant frequencies that interact with the barrier and Blight.
Elias Thorne believes the entity in the spires is still alive and hungry.
Elias Thorne is aware of the map's indication of a way station near the western edge of the city.
Kaelen exists and is an established character.
Kaelen is a young man.
Kaelen possesses a brass gauntlet on his wrist, which is a relic from an era before the Blight.
Kaelen possesses a lantern.
Kaelen has magical abilities, including summoning smoke and creating shields of light.
Kaelen sustained a grazing claw injury to his side that caused bleeding.
Kaelen entered the temple hall and disappeared into the darkness.
Kaelen is capable of guiding the resonance of the gauntlet to feed the barrier when awake and focused.
Kaelen is in a state of severe physical and magical exhaustion.
Maren exists and is an established character.
Maren possesses a vial of amber salve used for medical stabilization.
Maren identifies as a healer, though Aldric does not recognize her as a certified physician.
Torin exists and is an established character.
Torin possesses a leather bracer.
Torin is traveling with Elias, Kaelen, Maren, and Elara.
Torin acknowledges that the group has only bought time against the entity.
Elara exists and is an established character.
Aldric exists and is an established character.
Aldric is the proprietor of the Pick and Axe tavern.
Aldric is strict about administrative regulations and liability waivers.
